Overview

Cochabamba is a city in CB with a population of 841,200. The culinary heart of Bolivia, nestled in a fertile valley with a perfect spring-like climate year-round. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
